prompt: Build an 8-qubit circuit that prepares the phase-generalized GHZ state (|00000000> + e^{i*pi/6}*|11111111>) / sqrt(2), up to global phase (pi/6 radians is the relative phase between the |0^8> and |1^8> terms — this is NOT the standard GHZ state, the |1^8> term carries an extra e^{i*pi/6} phase factor relative to |0^8>).
